description: CNCF standard defining principles for declarative, version-controlled, pull-based automated reconciliation.
Architecture where in-cluster agents pull desired state from Git, eliminating external cluster credential exposure.
Continuous process comparing declared state in Git against live cluster state and applying updates to resolve differences.
Automated capability identifying divergence between live production resources and declared Git manifests.
Automated remediation action restoring cluster state to match declared Git manifests when drift occurs.
